# the project Conventions

> Global conventions for humans and AI agents, in six cores: CONVENTIONS (rules by category: WORKFLOW, GITHUB (repo, pull requests, actions, releases, deployments), SPECS (third-party and original document formats), FORMATS, SYSTEMS, REPO, DESIGN, INTERFACES, PACKAGING, CODE), AGENTS (always-on rules, agent behaviour rules, prompt engineering and a prompt library, skills, adapters), HUMANS (install, browse), CONTRIBUTING (extend, write, version, prompts), META (build pipeline, schema, compatibility registry) and TEMPLATES (skeletons for rules, prompts, skills, project agent files). Project identity and profile docs are separate from the core. Agents load rules lazily: read INDEX.md, then only files whose trigger matches the task.

Entry points: [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/SKILL.md), [INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/INDEX.md), [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/index.json). All stable rules in one file: [CONVENTIONS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS.md). Compatible third-party formats, specs and tools: [COMPATIBILITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/COMPATIBILITY.md).

## Always on
- [Global rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/global/AGENTS.md): Installed as global instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, …); always active

## Cores
- [CONVENTIONS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/README.md): Load when asked which conventions exist, how rules are organised, or before adding/promoting/demoting a rule.
- [AGENTS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/README.md): Load when installing the conventions into an agent harness, deciding on subagents, model or effort, or writing a prompt for an agent.
- [HUMANS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/HUMANS/README.md): Load when a person asks how to install, browse or use the conventions.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/README.md): Load when adding, changing, promoting, versioning or indexing a convention, or contributing to this repo.
- [META](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/META/README.md): Load when changing how this repo is built, checked, indexed or published (tools, schema, compatibility registry, site, CI).
- [TEMPLATES](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/TEMPLATES/README.md): Load when starting a new rule, prompt, skill, category or project agent file from a skeleton.

## Rules
- [Prompt engineering 101](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/101.md): Load when writing a prompt, system prompt or agent brief from scratch, or asked for prompt-engineering basics.
- [Prompts for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/AGENT-PROMPTS.md): Load when writing a system prompt, subagent or task brief for an agent that runs commands, edits files or calls tools.
- [Prompt classes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/CLASSES.md): Load when deciding which sections a prompt needs, or combining two kinds of work in one prompt.
- [Docs voice profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/DOCS-VOICE.md): Load when drafting or rewriting a README or guide in the house docs voice, or briefing an agent to write docs.
- [Meta-prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/META-PROMPTS.md): Load when asking an agent to write, review, tighten or test a prompt.
- [Task prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/TASK-PROMPTS.md): Load when looking for a ready prompt for everyday work: planning, debugging, reviewing, summarizing, distilling, deciding, learning.
- [Testing a prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/TESTING.md): Load when checking a prompt before use, or after it produced a wrong or uneven output.
- [Writing a prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/PROMPT/WRITING.md): Load when wording or tightening the lines of a prompt, or choosing its examples, placeholders and untrusted-input handling.
- [Token efficiency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/RULES/EFFICIENCY.md): Load when choosing a model or effort level, configuring a harness or subagent, writing instruction files, or a session grows long.
- [Subagents & tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/RULES/SUBAGENTS.md): Load when considering a subagent, parallel work, skills/MCP use, or long-running commands.
- [Conventions 101](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/101.md): Load when first using the conventions, setting them up for an agent, or applying them to an existing project.
- [Project decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/DECISIONS.md): Load when checking why the project adopted a policy, format, or compatibility change.
- [Conventions DIY](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/DIY.md): Load when building your own conventions repo (team, organization or personal) on this skeleton.
- [Indexing and formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/INDEXING.md): Load when adding or changing a rule file and wondering what to rebuild, or adding a new generated output format.
- [Rule lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/LIFECYCLE.md): Load when proposing, promoting, demoting or deprecating a convention, or tracking how a rule changed.
- [Prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/PROMPTS.md): Load when asking an agent to use, apply, extend or maintain the conventions, or looking for a ready prompt to paste.
- [Versioning the conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/VERSIONING.md): Load when deciding the version bump for a change to this conventions repo, releasing it, or pinning an install.
- [Writing a rule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/WRITING.md): Load when writing or reviewing a convention rule, deciding where a rule goes, or creating a category.
- [Shell environment & dotfiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/DOTFILES.md): Load when building or changing a shell setup: rc files, dotfiles, plugins, prompt, shell integrations.

- [Naming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/NAMING.md): Load when naming a repo, binary, package, env var, config key, file or doc.

- [Stack defaults](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/STACK.md): Load when starting a project or tool, or choosing a language or dependencies.
- [Colors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/DESIGN/COLORS.md): Load when any UI, TUI, CLI color, web page, theme, badge or graphic.

- [Awesome list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SPECS/THIRD-PARTY/AWESOME-LIST.md): Load when creating, editing or submitting an awesome list (`awesome-<topic>` repo).

- [Code of conduct](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SPECS/THIRD-PARTY/CODE-OF-CONDUCT-MD.md): Load when adding a code of conduct to a repo or organization, or opening a project to outside contributors.

- [macOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SYSTEMS/MACOS.md): Load when supporting macOS, or writing scripts or paths that must also run on macOS.
- [Nix and NixOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SYSTEMS/NIX.md): Load when targeting NixOS, Nix on another OS, or nix-darwin.
- [Platform support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SYSTEMS/SUPPORT.md): Load when deciding which operating systems a tool supports, writing platform notes in a README, or setting up a CI test matrix.
- [Windows via WSL2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SYSTEMS/WINDOWS-WSL2.md): Load when supporting Windows users or testing a tool under WSL2.
- [Branches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/BRANCHES.md): Load when creating branches, opening/merging PRs, releasing, or promoting/deprecating a convention.
- [Commits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/COMMITS.md): Load when writing a commit message or PR title.
- [Finish every change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/FINISH.md): Load when finishing a feature or fix, before calling work done.
- [Notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/NOTIFY.md): Load when a job runs > ~10 min, or a failure needs a human.
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/VERIFICATION.md): Load when any code change.

## Skills
- [deep](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/skills/deep/SKILL.md): Escalate to deep reasoning for hard problems — architecture and design decisions, cross-cutting refactors, bugs with unclear root cause, security-sensitive code, concurrency, or anything where a wrong first approach is expensive. Use it before writing code for such tasks. Do not use it for routine edits.

## Experimental
- [Localization (en + pl)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/LOCALIZATION.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or adds user-facing strings, locales or translations.
- [Modules (KUR)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/MODULES.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or builds a Kombinat/KUR plugin module.
- [v2 repo baseline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/REPO-BASELINE.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or ports a v1 project to the v2 baseline.
